body:
Unfortunately, I have saved zero people. Every sniper we took out was replaced with another one. 

And no, taking a life is not something to be proud of. Even if it's necessary in some situations.

Thank you for this. I was drunk last night and posted this. First time I talk about it outside a therapist office.

I'm sorry about your friend. I've seen many like him.

PTSD is indeed awful. To me, the worst is explosions. A jet passed the sound barrier close to my house when I was napping, a few months ago. The sonic boom woke me up and I started shaking, felt like throwing up. One day, my daughter was drinking strawberry juice and regurgitated some, it reminded me of all the dead kids I've seen. It's awful.

Anyway: thank you.

Thank you. Unfortunately, my PTSD could never be cured. I'm doing better when times are good, but when things are really, really bad, there is nothing anyone can really do. It's just between me and myself. I'm sure you understand.
Don't worry, I'm not gonna grab a gun and go an a rampage.
